name: Eri
source:
She flows from the eastern country to the town where the main character, Oto, lives, and runs a bar.

She is a big sister type who can't leave people in trouble.
She loves open-chest clothes, and you can't take your eyes off her plump body.
She is very attracted to Oto.


"If you feel like it, come visit me. I'll serve you."
